brain.commentary: Stress cross-asset regime, elevated crypto beta/volatility, and 95% expected shortfalls warrant materially reduced aggregate risk. Long signals in BTC, ETH, and SOL are marginal rather than high-conviction. ETC is critically fragile because price, volatility, liquidity, and tail-risk inputs are missing or zero; its signal should not receive capital until validated. BCH is also fragile due to negative alpha, weak institutional support, and poor liquidity. DOGE and LTC merit further caution because of negative composites and sub-par liquidity.
